name: HomeRoll
subtitle: Photos-style app for your Immich server

apps.name: HomeRoll
apps.subtitle: Your Immich library, the Apple Photos way
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone and iPad app for your own Immich server that looks and feels like Apple Photos: library with years, months and days, collections, memories, people, albums, folders, search, editing and automatic backup.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Locked Folder, instant collections, smoother swipe down

- **Locked Folder** (#68): new in Collections → Other. It shows the photos and videos in your Immich Locked Folder. The first time you enter your Immich PIN (or create one), after that Face ID is enough. Move photos in or out from the photo menu ("Move to Locked Folder" / "Remove from Locked Folder"). The folder locks again when you leave it or the app goes to the background.
- **Collections show right away** (#69): memories, featured photos and folders are kept on the iPhone, so your section order is there immediately instead of jumping after a few seconds.
- **Hidden** no longer shows deleted photos (they stay in Recently Deleted).
- **Swipe down to close** (#63): the photo follows your finger in every direction, also up. When you let go it flies into its tile in the grid, the grid stays the same size and the tile stays empty until the photo lands. The 3D button hides while you drag.

## Fixes for people, map, rename and hidden album

- **Map no longer freezes** (#67): the map now opens on the area with most photos and builds its pins in the background, also with many thousand photos.
- **Keyboard shows up when renaming** (#65, #66): renaming a person or a memory title now uses a small sheet with the text field focused, instead of an alert. The current name is filled in.
- **Link contact works again** (#65): picking a contact for a person opens the system contact picker directly.
- **People with more than 1000 photos** (#65): albums and people now load all their photos.
- **Don't feature this person** (#65): in the person menu. Photos of that person no longer show up in memories and featured photos.
- **Hidden and Recently Deleted** (#69): Face ID is asked right when you open them, with a button to try again and a hint when Face ID is turned off for HomeRoll.
- **Recent Days** (#69): shows the newest days again.
- **Translations** (#62): new texts are translated to English and Russian.

## Edit memories, spatial scenes for more photos

- **Edit a memory** (#62): in a memory, open all photos and tap Edit. Drag to reorder, delete, or add photos from your library. The order and added photos are kept, also when memories are rebuilt.
- **Spatial scene for regular photos** (#61): the spatial scene button now also shows for photos without depth data. The subject is lifted in front and the background gets an estimated depth, so tilting the phone gives the same 3D effect as for portrait photos.

## Swipe down like Photos, zoom in videos

- **Swipe down to close** (#63): only the photo moves now, the grid already shows behind it and its tile stays empty until the photo lands there. Neighbouring photos no longer slide in while swiping.
- **Pinch to zoom in videos** (#64), with panning and double tap, like photos.
- **Folder covers** (#60) stay in place instead of reloading every time you open Collections, also after restarting the app.

## Backup: next item gets ready while one uploads

- **Faster backup on slow or distant connections**: with the app open, the next photo or video is already prepared (copied, checked with your server) while the current one uploads, so the line no longer sits idle between items. Over a long-distance VPN this more than doubled the speed in testing. At most one video is handled at a time, and in the background it's still one item after the other.
- Each tile that's uploading shows its own progress ring.
